text: Platten stands out because the boobox is noticeably wider than most of the others, which makes the spread look much larger. The blue dots also feel more spread out and not even compared to the rest of the plots. Plat 15 also looks a little different because the blue dots are packed closer together while the red looks more stretched out than the nearby panels.
